findings.summary: Command 'pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/shell.spec.ts' could not run: tests/e2e/ does not exist yet and playwright.config.ts, fixtures and the backend belong to other units/integration. Runtime checks for FitPulse header, no V-Stage text, no password input, document.fonts.check for Inter and JetBrains Mono, and blocked external requests remain unverified here.
Play dev-link (Settings -> Instalar App -> Linkar pasta) showing the shell with a green badge needs the Play desktop and the backend lane; not runnable in this unit.

The /api proxy in vite.config.ts forwards the browser Host header (changeOrigin false), so the backend host guard must accept 127.0.0.1 and localhost on the Vite PORT as well as BACKEND_PORT. server/http/requestGuards.ts does not exist yet, so this cross-lane check is deferred to integration and was not verified.

evidence.summary: QA re-run: tsc --noEmit && vite build succeeded. Full output in build.log; exit code in build.exit.

dist/index.html has no external href or src. dist/assets CSS has 40 @font-face rules (Inter 28 references, JetBrains Mono 12), 74 bundled Inter and JetBrains Mono woff/woff2 files, and no external url(), @import or http(s) reference.

--font-structure resolves to Inter and --font-machine to JetBrains Mono (src/styles/tokens.css). src/main.tsx bundles @fontsource inter 400/500/600/700 and jetbrains-mono 400/500. No http(s) URL in src/ or index.html outside localhost.

Read App.tsx, AppShell.tsx, main.tsx and button.tsx: no defect found. The shell renders the FitPulse brand, a 'Principal' nav, a main landmark with id conteudo and a skip link. No 'V-Stage' string in src/ or index.html. Tailwind utilities used by the shell and button are emitted in the built CSS.

messages.text: Run 'pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/shell.spec.ts' once playwright.config.ts, fixtures and the backend exist. Expect 'FitPulse' in the header, no 'V-Stage', no password input, document.fonts.check('16px Inter') and document.fonts.check('16px "JetBrains Mono"'), and no external requests.

Backend host guard must accept Host 127.0.0.1:PORT and localhost:PORT (Vite PORT) as well as BACKEND_PORT, because vite.config.ts proxies /api with changeOrigin false. Otherwise every proxied request gets 403.

Routes #/empresas, #/empresa/:companyId, #/diagnostico/:diagnosisId and #/resultado/:diagnosisId render PendingScreen until the companies, questionnaire and result units replace their route elements in src/App.tsx. The theme toggle and tour of the prototype top bar are not in AppShell and belong to Phase 3.
